scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:ingress: concurrently -n api,web,proxy -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run build:watch -w web" "node scripts/dev-ingress-proxy.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p web
